source: Hand-tuned for gameplay; capacities and prices loosely based on public launch provider figures and NASA 'Design and Develop Science Missions'

rows: Share a big rocket with dozens of other satellites. Cheap, but you only go where the rocket goes (sun-synchronous orbit).
A small dedicated rocket. Your own ride to low orbit, and a tiny payload can even reach the Moon.
Launched from under an airplane. Flexible, but expensive for how little it carries.
Workhorse medium-lift rocket. Reaches every orbit in this game.
Heavy lifter for big spacecraft headed to high orbits or the Moon.
NASA's Moon rocket. Enormous capacity and an enormous price tag.
